exports: JsonWriter::new(sink: &mut dyn ByteSink, limits: EncodeLimits) -> JsonWriter<'_>

test_vectors.name: constructor_and_drop_do_not_emit_or_reserve
test_vectors.vector: Construct and drop over an existing prefix with a recording sink
test_vectors.expected: Empty frames, false root/poison flags, zero new bytes and no sink calls

test_vectors.name: nested_objects_arrays_and_duplicate_keys_have_exact_separators
test_vectors.vector: Object containing null, booleans, nested containers, duplicate x keys and an empty key
test_vectors.expected: Compact JSON with correct commas/colons and no trailing separators

test_vectors.name: scalar_roots_and_empty_containers
test_vectors.vector: null, true, false, empty string, empty array and empty object
test_vectors.expected: Each forms exactly one valid root with exact output length

test_vectors.name: integer_extremes_are_exact_minimal_decimal
test_vectors.expected: Exact base-10 tokens without padding, leading plus or signed overflow

test_vectors.name: finite_floats_roundtrip_bits_including_subnormals_and_negative_zero
test_vectors.vector: Signed zero, 0.1, long significand, minimum normal, smallest/largest subnormals, finite extrema and powers of ten
test_vectors.expected: Bit-identical roundtrips; explicit -0; shortest significant digits; compact ordinary/scientific notation

test_vectors.name: nonfinite_float_errors_precede_all_output_and_poison
test_vectors.vector: NaN, signed NaN payload and both infinities
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InvalidNumber before writes and permanent writer poisoning

test_vectors.name: decimal_vectors_preserve_scale_sign_and_extreme_coefficients
test_vectors.vector: 123 at scale 2, signed fractions, zero with scale, trailing fractional zeros, i128 extrema and scale 38
test_vectors.expected: Exact quoted fixed-point text, including i128::MIN and leading fractional zeros

test_vectors.name: decimal_scale_rejection_is_atomic_and_poisoning
test_vectors.vector: i128::MIN with scales 39 and 255
test_vectors.expected: Encode/DecimalScaleMismatch without output, followed by InternalError on reuse

test_vectors.name: every_control_character_uses_the_exact_lowercase_escape
test_vectors.vector: All bytes U+0000 through U+001F in one valid UTF-8 string
test_vectors.expected: Canonical short escapes and lowercase six-byte Unicode escapes; exact escaped_string_len agreement

test_vectors.name: quotes_backslashes_utf8_and_slashes_escape_identically_in_keys_and_values
test_vectors.vector: Quotes, backslash, slash, accented text, emoji, U+2028/U+2029, DEL and embedded NUL
test_vectors.expected: Only required escaping; all other UTF-8 unchanged; identical key/value string encoding

test_vectors.name: string_and_key_limits_count_decoded_utf8_bytes
test_vectors.vector: Four-byte emoji at limit 4, emoji plus ASCII beyond limit, escaped controls and empty strings/keys at limit 0
test_vectors.expected: Decoded byte bounds are inclusive and violations publish no token prefix

test_vectors.name: exact_output_limit_includes_every_escape_and_quote
test_vectors.vector: Empty, ASCII, NUL, short escapes and non-ASCII strings with exact and one-byte-short output limits
test_vectors.expected: Exact limit succeeds; one-byte-short limit fails before any string output

test_vectors.name: output_budget_and_finish_length_exclude_existing_prefix
test_vectors.vector: Existing prefix followed by null under limit 4; subsequent writer with limit 0
test_vectors.expected: finish returns 4; prefix remains intact; zero output budget rejects a value atomically

test_vectors.name: commas_colons_and_closing_delimiters_are_budgeted_before_writing
test_vectors.vector: Array second item, empty object key plus colon, and array close at insufficient budgets
test_vectors.expected: No partial separator/token on budget failure; counts and frames remain uncommitted

test_vectors.name: number_and_decimal_content_limits_are_inclusive
test_vectors.vector: Two-byte integer/float/decimal content boundaries, three-byte rejections and max_number_bytes 0
test_vectors.expected: Number text limits include signs and decimal points while excluding decimal wrapper quotes

test_vectors.name: decimal_string_and_output_limits_include_the_correct_bytes
test_vectors.vector: Quoted 1.23 at content limit 4 and total limit 6, then each bound reduced by one
test_vectors.expected: Both content and complete output bounds enforced before publication

test_vectors.name: depth_zero_allows_scalars_and_rejects_root_containers
test_vectors.vector: Scalar roots and both root container types with max_depth 0
test_vectors.expected: Scalars succeed; containers return DepthLimitExceeded with unchanged state/output

test_vectors.name: inclusive_depth_and_frame_counts_do_not_double_count_children
test_vectors.vector: Array/object nesting at depth 2 with one item/property, followed by a depth-3 attempt
test_vectors.expected: Exact depth succeeds, parent counted once, excess depth rejected before delimiter output

test_vectors.name: zero_container_budget_accepts_empty_containers_only
test_vectors.vector: Empty object/array and attempted first property/item at max_container_items 0
test_vectors.expected: Empty containers valid; first member/item rejected before any member bytes

test_vectors.name: second_array_item_and_object_property_fail_before_the_comma
test_vectors.vector: One accepted item/property and attempted second under item limit 1
test_vectors.expected: BudgetExhausted with unchanged output and count 1

test_vectors.name: maximum_item_counter_does_not_wrap
test_vectors.vector: Private counters seeded at u32::MAX - 1; public operations accept final item/property and reject another
test_vectors.expected: Inclusive u32 maximum reached without overflow or output on subsequent rejection

test_vectors.name: invalid_operation_orders_poison_without_extra_output
test_vectors.vector: Ten cases covering misplaced keys/values, mismatched/unmatched closes, pending object value and second root
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InvalidSyntax before extra output, followed by permanent poisoning

test_vectors.name: unfinished_messages_report_unexpected_eof_and_drop_does_not_close
test_vectors.vector: No root, open containers, pending key value and dropping an open array containing null
test_vectors.expected: finish returns UnexpectedEof; consuming or dropping never appends closing delimiters

test_vectors.name: every_operation_and_finish_reject_a_poisoned_writer
test_vectors.vector: Call every writer operation after an initial syntax error, including invalid numeric inputs
test_vectors.expected: InternalError takes precedence on every subsequent call without sink writes

test_vectors.name: raw_preserves_spelling_whitespace_and_parent_item_accounting
test_vectors.vector: Whitespace-wrapped object with duplicate keys, explicit numeric exponent and Unicode escape inserted into array/object
test_vectors.expected: Exact original raw bytes preserved and fragment counted as one surrounding value

test_vectors.name: raw_depth_is_relative_to_current_open_containers
test_vectors.vector: Depth-2 raw fragment at root or inside a writer array, and raw scalar at maximum writer depth
test_vectors.expected: Combined depth enforced; scalar adds zero depth; rejection occurs before fragment output

test_vectors.name: raw_revalidates_nested_counts_decoded_strings_and_number_lengths
test_vectors.vector: Loosely validated fragments containing excessive nested members, surrogate-pair emoji, escaped keys, long number and whitespace overhead
test_vectors.expected: Current limits rechecked recursively by bounded raw parser; four-byte decoded emoji accepted exactly at limit 4

test_vectors.name: raw_whole_token_reservation_includes_parent_comma
test_vectors.vector: Whitespace-wrapped null after array item 1 with output limits 9 and 8
test_vectors.expected: Comma plus entire fragment reserved; limit 9 accepts fragment but rejects close, limit 8 rejects before comma

test_vectors.name: raw_revalidation_preserves_parser_error_offsets
test_vectors.vector: Crate-internal malformed fragment [0,] with untrusted metadata
test_vectors.expected: Exact raw validator error propagated, including byte offset, without output

test_vectors.name: external_reservation_failure_retains_metadata_and_never_starts_value
test_vectors.vector: Container opening with an injected reservation failure carrying transport/schema/field metadata
test_vectors.expected: Original error preserved, no writes/root/frame committed, permanent poisoning

test_vectors.name: partial_external_writes_are_visible_and_do_not_commit_syntax_state
test_vectors.vector: Seven-byte escaped string fails after two published bytes
test_vectors.expected: Full token reserved once; visible prefix retained; original error preserved; root uncommitted

test_vectors.name: external_failure_after_comma_never_increments_parent_count
test_vectors.vector: Sink accepts [0, then rejects the next null token
test_vectors.expected: Partial comma remains visible, previous count stays 1, writer poisoned

test_vectors.name: incorrect_external_success_lengths_poison_writer
test_vectors.vector: Sink reserve improperly appends a byte or write reports success without appending
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InternalError from LimitedSink propagated and no successful continuation

test_vectors.name: complete_string_key_and_number_tokens_are_reserved_once_before_emission
test_vectors.vector: Object with escaped key, UTF-8/escaped value and u64::MAX
test_vectors.expected: Six complete-token reservations and exact final JSON
